title: In this French city, social diversity in schools has almost disappeared
subhead: According to studies, the southern city of Perpignan is the most educationally segregated in France. It's divided between private schools, which rank among the most privileged in the country, and public schools, which, in almost every case, sit at the exact opposite end of the social scale.

title: Thousands of Americans are forced to live in their cars across Los Angeles
subhead: Several thousand people live in a car, van or camper in the city of Los Angeles. The situation highlights the growing difficulties of low-income Americans to find stable housing, a major problem in the United States.

subhead: Annie Ernaux's books, which delve into the intimate side of the female experience, have found unprecedented resonance among women. The work of the Nobel laureate in literature echoed through the voices of two actresses – Tess Barthélemy in a film directed by her mother, Judith Godrèche, and Suzanne de Baecque in a solo stage performance – as well as in the powerful readings by high school girls in a documentary by Claire Simon.
